room.kicker: Hi. I'm Aryan — full-stack developer and AI/ML engineer, and I care about one thing more than most

room.caption: From farms and classrooms to hackathon stages

room.label: The problem
room.text: Cattle classification for the Rashtriya Gokul Mission, crop disease detection for farmers, a CBT chatbot for students. Each one started with a person, not a dataset.

room.label: How I think
room.text: Before I write a line of code I learn who it is for, what it has to do and what success looks like. The stack comes after. The thinking comes first.

room.label: What's next
room.text: IEEE Code Astraa 2025 finalist, Smart India Hackathon 2024 and 2025, and a live demo for 2,000+ people. Now open to internships, freelance work and collaborations.

paragraphs: I started in 2023 as a BCA student at Galgotias University, sure of one thing: I didn't want to spend my time building demos that never leave a laptop.

Hackathons became my classroom. Smart India Hackathon put me in front of farmers and the Rashtriya Gokul Mission; Code Astraa put a mental-health chatbot in front of judges; the UP International Trade Show put my crop disease system in front of 2,000+ people. Each one taught me the same thing: understand the person first, then design, then code, one project at a time
story.photoAlt: Aryan Singh by a lake, in a mustard t-shirt, looking off to the side

year.label: Since
year.statement: Most of what I know, I taught myself — which is exactly why I care about the details most people skip.

steps.title: Understand the problem
steps.text: Talk to the people who have it. Farmers, students and shelters shaped my last projects more than any spec.

steps.title: Build the smallest real thing
steps.text: Get a working model or app in front of users early, then improve it with what they actually do.

steps.title: Ship and present
steps.text: Deploy it, measure it, and explain it clearly, whether to a hackathon jury or 2,000 people at a trade show.

faq.question: Are you open to internships?
faq.answer: Yes. I'm actively seeking internship opportunities in full-stack and AI/ML engineering, remote or in the Greater Delhi Area.

faq.question: Do you take freelance projects?
faq.answer: Yes. I take on web apps, AI/ML prototypes and portfolio sites. Use the contact form and tell me what you're building.

faq.question: What do you work with most?
faq.answer: Python, React, Node.js, FastAPI, TensorFlow, LangChain, OpenCV and TypeScript day to day.

faq.question: Where are you based?
faq.answer: Greater Delhi Area, India (IST). I work with people in any time zone.
